description: Synthetic employee key, for example E00001. Not a real identifier.
First day of work. ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.
Last day of work. Blank when the employee is still active at the end of the data.
voluntary (employee chose to leave) or involuntary (employer decision). Blank when active.
employee_id of the manager. Blank for Vice-Presidents, who sit at the top of this fictional hierarchy.
Full-time, Part-time or Contract. Drives scheduled hours per day (7.5, 4.5, 7.5).
FR or EN. Blank when not recorded (about 1 percent of employees, a planted data quality issue).
Job level key, JL1 to JL6.
1 is the most junior level, 6 the most senior. Use for sorting.
Year and month, for example 2026-09. Sorts correctly as text.
1 for Monday to Friday, else 0. Statutory holidays are not modelled.
Last calendar day of the month of this date.
1 when this date is the last day of its month.
1 when the date is on or before the as-of date of the data (2026-09-30).
Day of the absence. One row per employee per day.
Hours absent that day. A full day is the employee's daily scheduled hours, a half day is half of it.
Backfill (replaces a departure) or Growth (new role).
Filled, Open (not yet filled at the as-of date) or Cancelled.
Start date of the person hired. Blank unless status is Filled.
Calendar days from open_date to filled_date. Blank unless status is Filled.
Last day of the month. One row per employee who was employed at any point in that month.
Key to employees.employee_id. Hidden in the Power BI model, never shown in visuals.
1 if still employed after the last day of the month, else 0. Headcount is the sum of this column.
1 if the hire_date falls in this month. Hires is the sum of this column.
Weekday count while employed in the month times daily hours. Denominator of the absence rate.
Key to employees.employee_id. Hidden in the Power BI model.
Whole months between hire_date and termination_date.
Key to employees.employee_id. Hidden in the Power BI model.
1 for Sick, Family and Personal, 0 for Vacation. Vacation is planned leave and is not an absence for the rate.
